claims: valid draft creation
successful draft edit
invalid draft edit does not mutate
submission freezes the current revision for review
browser edit then submit
unknown actor cannot review
General Manager cannot skip first-stage review
employee cannot review own expense
authorized approver can approve or reject only the exact current submitted revision
old revision cannot be reviewed
first-stage approval is not final
approver cannot perform final review
General Manager can approve the same manager_pending revision to final approved
General Manager can reject at final stage
General Manager final decision cannot target a stale revision
first-stage rejection remains in history
General Manager-stage rejection remains in history
revision increments after either-stage rejection
new revision must traverse approval stages again
old revision and decisions remain inspectable
first-stage decision cannot target old revision
final-stage decision cannot target old revision
changed content creates a new revision after rejection
prior approval does not float to a new revision
both successful approval decisions reference the same exact revision
ordered revisions retained
ordered stage-one and General Manager decisions retain actor and actor_role
rejected and approved decisions coexist in history
history is visible through the browser path
actor-role behavior remains available after restart
both approval-stage decisions survive restart
revision and decision history survives store reopen
